title: This sub just shattered my brain
content: I'm ...speechless? I plan on making a longer post later, and using AI to try and make some images , but I mean, I just had to quickly express my pure astonishment here because what the heck????? Some fleeting things I'm curious about - What is the time of day in your mall world? For me, it's ALWAYS dusk, and the clock is ticking - as in, I feel a sense of urgency to make it from place to place before the sun goes completely down. A few occasions I've been in the apartment areas a little too close to it being totally nighttime and it's unreal the sense of fear that was enveloping me. Does anyone else have a helper? For me it's always this girl I don't know, but always recognize her energy when she appears in mallworld. She only shows up around the apartments and when we have classes. Mainly she just leads me from place to place, otherwise I just KNOW I'd get lost. Any common color schemes in relation to the places? Apartment areas for me have a yellow hue that I can't really explain. The mall itself always feels magenta or red, definitely neon. The school is just chaotic, I can't recall a color scheme. There's also the cylinder shaped luxury building on the water, lots of white colors. Big windows. God there's so much I could say about this.
